name: University of Leicester

facts.text: The University of Leicester's main campus is a mile south of the city centre, next to Victoria Park.
In 2024/25 Leicester had 18,990 students: 14,675 undergraduates and 4,315 postgraduates.
Leicester is known for inventing genetic (DNA) fingerprinting in 1984, for the discovery and identification of King Richard III's remains, and for a leading academic space research centre.
The David Wilson Library opened in 2008 after a £32 million redevelopment, and the 18-storey Attenborough Tower houses arts and humanities departments.
Leicester became a university by royal charter in 1957 and kept a UK top-30 place in The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026.
